verdict.rationale: Weave documents a programmatic, imperative evaluation API (Evaluation objects with datasets and scorers) that can be run against repeatable test cases. Its marketing claims these evaluations 'catch regressions before they reach users', which points toward pre-deployment checks. However, no evidence describes CI integration, pass/fail thresholds, exit codes, or deployment gating, so the CI/gating half of the story rests only on the API being code-driven. Missing for 10: documented CI integration or CI examples, threshold-based pass/fail or exit-code gating of deployments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run evals in CI and gate deployments on their results

citations.quote: Measure every improvement to your harnesses and models with confidence with a flexible imperative evaluation API. Weave provides powerful evaluation comparisons and visualizations to catch regressions before they reach users
measure your LLM application’s performance against repeatable test cases, compare changes over time, and identify regressions
the core of the workflow is the _`Evaluation` object_, which defines: A `Dataset` or list of dictionaries for test examples. One or more scoring functions.
